body.title: Editor approval prompt
body.summary: In vscode-plugin subscribe to approval.subscribe at attach (through the controller) and show each request as a notification with Approve and Decline actions that names the tool, repository and arguments, answering through approval.answer and removing it on a cancel frame.
acceptanceChecks: the editor subscribes at attach and shows a notification for a raised request with the tool, repository and arguments
choosing Approve or Decline sends approval.answer
a cancel frame closes the notification
the stream is reopened after the daemon restarts

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/approval-subscribe.test.ts: the editor and chat client receive a gate frame, show the exact call and send approval.answer
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/approval-subscribe.test.ts: a cancel frame closes the notification and the stream is reopened after a restart
